title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on the cold wooden floor of an old library. The door is shut and a keypad glows beside it. Dust hangs in the stale air. Somewhere in this room is the way out.
room_description: A cramped, dusty library. You can see an oak desk with a drawer, a tall bookshelf, an antique globe, a painting of a lighthouse, and the exit door with its keypad.

desk.name: oak desk
desk.description: A heavy oak desk covered in dust. A folded note lies on top. Its drawer has a small 4-digit combination dial.

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.description: Most books are grey with dust, but four stand out with fresh spines: 'Winter', 'Spring', 'Summer' and 'Autumn'. Inside each cover a single digit is handwritten: Winter 8, Spring 2, Summer 5, Autumn 4.

drawer.name: desk drawer
drawer.description: The desk drawer is held shut by a 4-digit combination dial.

lock.unlock_text: The dial clicks and the drawer slides open. Inside lies a small brass key.

globe.name: antique globe
globe.description: A large antique globe. There is a tiny keyhole hidden on the equator.

lock.unlock_text: The brass key turns. The globe splits open along the equator, revealing a UV flashlight.

painting.name: lighthouse painting
painting.description: An oil painting of a lighthouse at night. The brushwork around the lighthouse looks oddly thick.

uv_flashlight.text: Under the violet light, glowing digits appear on the lighthouse: 7 1 9 3.

door.name: exit door
door.description: A heavy door with a glowing 4-digit keypad. It will not budge.

lock.unlock_text: The keypad flashes green. With a heavy clunk the door swings open. Fresh air rushes in — you are free!

note.name: folded note
note.description: The note reads: 'The seasons turn, beginning when the snow melts.'

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.description: A small brass key, warm from the drawer.

uv_flashlight.name: UV flashlight
uv_flashlight.description: A compact flashlight that gives off a violet ultraviolet glow.

puzzles.drawer_code: Open the drawer with the seasons code
puzzles.globe_key: Unlock the globe with the brass key
puzzles.painting_uv: Reveal the hidden code on the painting

hints.text: There is a note on the desk — read it.
Some books on the shelf look newer than the rest.
The note talks about the seasons. Put the book digits in season order, starting in spring.
Take what you found in the drawer.
Something round in this room has a keyhole.
Take what was inside the globe.
Thick paint can hide things that only special light reveals.
You have the code. Try it on the door keypad.
